integrity: The mathematical proof is analytic and self-contained; the limited finite sanity computation is supplementary and not an infinite certificate. Originality is compared against specified accessible sources and indexed results, not asserted as a proof of universal uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: The exact classification concerns strictly decreasing positive sequences converging to zero and their induced compact subspaces of the real line; no general compact-metric characterization is claimed. The final published 2025 version of the motivating paper was not checked in full.
title: A lacunarity dichotomy for pointwise Lipschitz norm attainment on convergent sequences
